description: The Envy sits at the sharp end of BMX progression—a snapshot of how far design has come, and a hint at where it’s heading. Each launch draws more attention than anything else in the range, and it’s easy to see why. The ENVY is built by selecting only the finest parts from across our lineup and combining them into a single, highly refined complete. Lightweight doesn’t mean fragile. Built around the Envy XLT frame and paired with the Éclat Storm XLT fork, E440 rims, and Seismic hubs, it delivers elite-level spec without unnecessary weight. Designed for hard street and park riding, it’s built to take abuse while staying responsive and fast. AVAILABLE IN 20.5” OR 21” IN RSD AND LSD. INCLUDES LIFETIME GUARANTEE ON THE FRAME & FORK
